caption: Figure 1: Overview of our approach. We combine a pre-trained retriever ( Query Encoder + Document Index ) with a pre-trained seq2seq model ( Generator ) and fine-tune end-to-end. For query x , we use Maximum Inner Product Search (MIPS) to find the top-K documents z i . For final prediction y , we treat z as a latent variable and marginalize over seq2seq predictions given different documents.
description: This is a diagram showing an end-to-end model for question answering. It combines a pre-trained retriever with a pre-trained seq2seq model and fine-tunes them end-to-end. The model takes a query, encodes it, and uses Maximum Inner Product Search to find relevant documents. The generator then uses these documents to generate an answer. The model marginalizes over different documents to make the final prediction.

caption: Figure 2: RAG-Token document posterior p ( z i | x, y i , y - i ) for each generated token for input 'Hemingway" for Jeopardy generation with 5 retrieved documents. The posterior for document 1 is high when generating 'A Farewell to Arms" and for document 2 when generating 'The Sun Also Rises".
description:
Figure 2 displays a heatmap showing the RAG-Token document posterior probabilities for each generated token in a Jeopardy game input 'Hemingway'. The heatmap represents the posterior probabilities for five retrieved documents (Doc 1 to Doc 5) across various generated tokens. The highest posterior probability is observed for Doc 1 when generating 'A Farewell to Arms' and for Doc 2 when generating 'The Sun Also Rises'. The lowest probabilities are seen for other tokens across the documents.

Text in figure: Doc 1, Doc 2, Doc 3, Doc 4, Doc 5, BOSS, The, Sun, Also, Rises, is, a, novel, by, this, author, or, A, Farewell, to, Arms.

caption: Figure 3: Left: NQ performance as more documents are retrieved. Center: Retrieval recall performance in NQ. Right: MS-MARCO Bleu-1 and Rouge-L as more documents are retrieved.
description:
This figure consists of three plots showing performance metrics for different models as the number of retrieved documents increases. The left plot shows NQ Exact Match performance, with RAG-Tok and RAG-Seq models. RAG-Tok starts higher and remains above RAG-Seq throughout. The center plot displays NQ Answer Recall, where RAG-Tok and RAG-Seq models are again compared, with RAG-Tok leading. The right plot presents MS-MARCO Bleu-1 and Rouge-L scores, with RAG-Tok R-L and RAG-Seq B-1 models. RAG-Tok R-L starts higher and maintains a lead over RAG-Seq B-1.

Text in figure: NQ Exact Match, NQ Answer Recall, Bleu-1, Rouge-L, RAG-Tok, RAG-Seq, Fixed DPR, BM25.
